Team —

We need a quick, surgical pass on the Q1 commit set to tighten the board narrative next week. Objective is twofold: (1) ensure every commit in the board corridor has stage-level evidence and a one-line commit rationale; (2) flag anything that should be moved out of commit (or reclassified) before the investor packet.

Ask (owners listed inline):
- Sales owners (Ben) — update stage on every deal in HubSpot to the freshest stage (no guesses). If a deal is marked "commit" but lacks evidence, move it to "verifying" and leave a short note. Use stage_update_template.csv attached.
- Finance/RevOps (Neha) — run a pivot of bookings by close date vs sales-estimate and call out any >30% timing variance. Share as a short table in Drive.
- Ops/Leadership (Vivek) — we will need a 20–30 min run-through of the most material 8 deals; propose times below.

Deadline: Please finish updates by EOD Thursday 1/8 so I can bake the narrative on Friday morning.

Attachments: Q1_commit_evidence.xlsx (template for evidence checklist), stage_update_template.csv
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2Bq-example-forecast-evidence | HubSpot deal list: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9421

Why this matters: investor questions last board cycle flagged a handful of bookings that were borderline on timing. We need defensible evidence (POs, signed contracts, procurement dates) for anything counted toward the corridor.

If anyone expects a capacity issue with this timeline, flag it now. I’ll coordinate escalations.

Thanks —
Grace
